verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never names an official client SDK or library for any language. What it does show is a CLI, a Management API, auto-generated REST and GraphQL APIs, an OpenAPI spec, type generation, and MCP and agent skills. These are APIs, tooling and building blocks next to an SDK, not documented SDKs, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
